identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][demo] Remediate flagship Observatory render artifacts and presentation proof

values.task_boundary: Correct the visible presentation defects in the existing flagship Observatory without rewriting Runtime v3, Unity-MCP, or licensed asset publication boundaries.
deliverables: Clean flagship Observatory hero composition without corrupted-looking cyan or green artifacts
Grounded architecture and terrain with controlled lighting and material readability
Preserved fixed operator shell and truthful runtime classifications
Fresh Full HD and QHD Play Mode captures
Direct proof index linking the implementation and visual evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: no conspicuous cyan or green block artifacts, corrupted particles, broken emissive meshes, or accidental debug geometry remain in the hero frame
AC-2: architecture and terrain are grounded and continuous with no visible floating supports, disconnected ramps, exposed voids, or clipped major structures
AC-3: lighting preserves material detail and depth without blown cyan highlights or crushed black regions
AC-4: the fixed operator shell remains crisp, aligned, non-overlapping, and internally scrollable only at both target resolutions
AC-5: runtime state remains fail-closed and never presents fixtures as live Polis truth
AC-6: direct Unity proof identifies the intended FastWork project, flagship scene, and clean Play Mode result
AC-7: fresh 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 evidence is retained and visually inspected
AC-8: focused contract validation and diff hygiene pass without player or owner binary builds
AC-9: the proof index links the actual Unity evidence and implementation PR rather than a terminal metadata branch
AC-10: every encountered tooling anomaly is retained in #5683 or routed to a named follow-up
dependencies: Operator-provisioned FastWork Unity project and licensed local asset packs
repo_inputs: Repository Unity-MCP CLI and #4739 alignment probe
non_goals: No Runtime v3 or C-SDLC rewrite
No player binary or replacement owner binary build
No unsupported live cloud or runtime claims
